feature: OR / NOT predicate combinators and parenthesized grouping in WHERE

scenarios.name: OR matches rows satisfying either branch
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.severity_score < 10 OR n.data.severity_score > 25 RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: NOT negates a comparison
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/boolean (NOT negation of a predicate)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE NOT n.data.kind = "island" RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: parenthesized grouping overrides AND/OR precedence
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.kind = "neighbor" AND (n.data.severity_score < 15 OR n.data.severity_score > 25) RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: NOT distributes over an AND (De Morgan)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE NOT (n.data.kind = "neighbor" AND n.data.is_open = true) RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: OR composes with an IN-list
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/boolean (OR composed with IN membership)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.kind IN ["island"] OR n.data.severity_score > 25 RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: NOT in the aggregation path narrows before the COUNT
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/boolean (NOT filter applied before aggregation)
scenarios.query: MATCH (h)-[:PG_LINKS]->(n:pg_node) WHERE NOT n.data.kind = "island" RETURN h.entity_id AS src, COUNT(n) AS c

scenarios.name: De Morgan — NOT over a disjunction keeps the band between the bounds
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/boolean (De Morgan over a disjunction: NOT (a OR b))
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE NOT (n.data.severity_score < 10 OR n.data.severity_score > 25) RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: double negation NOT NOT collapses to the inner predicate
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/boolean (double negation NOT NOT x)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE NOT (NOT n.data.kind = "island") RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: three chained AND operands narrow left-to-right
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/boolean (AND/OR associativity with 3+ chained operands)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.kind = "neighbor" AND n.data.severity_score > 10 AND n.data.severity_score < 30 RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id
